About

Gulberg ke dil mein ek saada, pur-sukoon hotel

Mall View Hotel Lahore ke Gulberg V ilaqe mein, Canal Bank Road par Aziz Avenue par waqeh hai. Ye Punjab Government ki registered hotels ki list mein shamil ek 1-star hotel hai — karobari safar ho ya khandani visit, shehar ke markazi ilaqon tak asaan rasai ke saath bunyadi sahulatayn faraham karta hai.

Hotel mein 10 air-conditioned guestrooms hain. Mehmanon ke liye free WiFi, complimentary breakfast aur 24-hour reception ki sahulat mojood hai, jabke on-site restaurant mein Pakistani, Continental aur Chinese khane dastiyab hain.

Location is ki sab se bari khubi hai — Bagh-e-Jinnah aur Lahore Zoo qareeb hain, aur Canal Bank Road se Gulberg, Mall Road aur shehar ke deegar ilaqon tak ana jana asaan hai.
